# point-in-polygon test for demo2 B/C and A/B
poly_bc=[(2,5),(10,13),(11,9),(6,4)] # r,c

def inside(x,y,poly): # x=r,y=c point ray
    res=False
    for (x1,y1),(x2,y2) in zip(poly,poly[1:]+poly[:1]):
        if (y1>y)!=(y2>y):
            xint=x1+(y-y1)*(x2-x1)/(y2-y1)
            if xint>x: res=not res
    return res
for r in range(16):
    print(r,[c for c in range(16) if inside(r,c,poly_bc)])
